description: This file defines the AuthProviderChain class, which manages multiple authentication providers, allowing to add providers, ensuring no duplicates or conflicting priorities, and attempting authentication through them based on priorities.

classes.name: AuthProviderChain
classes.description: Manages a chain of authentication providers, supporting addition and prioritized authentication attempts.

methods.name: addProvider
methods.description: Adds an authentication provider to the chain, ensuring no duplicate classes or conflicting priorities.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Attempts to authenticate using the added providers, ordered by their priorities.
